newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: Argentine Sept industrial output up 9.2 pct-FIEL.
newsitem.headline: Argentine Sept industrial output up 9.2 pct-FIEL.

text.p: Argentina's private consultancy FIEL Monday revised its industrial production growth estimates for September, putting them at 9.2 percent versus September last year.
It also revised its third quarter growth estimates to 9.8 percent versus the same period last year.
Last week it forecast a 9.7 percent growth in September and a 10.1 percent increase in the third quarter.
Official industrial output figures are due for release on October 29.
September production dropped 3.7 percent from August. FIEL said the decline was partly explained by fewer working days in the month.
The third quarter grew 1.3 percent on the previous quarter, marking the second three-month period of positive growth after a 12-month-long recession.
Of the 19 industrial sectors that make up the FIEL index, 13 showed gains for the first nine months of the year versus the same period 1995 and six showed declines.
